## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change and any related issue.

## Validation

List relevant local/CI checks and Preview verification. For UI changes, include
screenshots. State remaining gaps and any migration or operator action.

- [ ] Relevant documentation updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private setup links or customer data included.
- [ ] Dependency/access-control changes include the relevant security review.

For unpatched vulnerabilities, use the private reporting process in SECURITY.md.
